methodology.key_distribution: keys are a seeded random permutation of 1..N (unique, dense), inserted in random order
methodology.timing_boundary: steady_clock around QueryEngine::execute_plan with a prepared plan (parse and plan excluded); rows are materialised; inserts timed in batches of 1000 with payload generation excluded
methodology.cache_conditions: warm OS page cache; caches were not dropped between runs
methodology.warmup: each measurement runs warmup_runs_per_measurement untimed executions first
methodology.verification: every query result is checked against the expected row count; heap/index consistency is checked after loading
